results.raw: False. The State Gazette uses sequential issue numbers (e.g., 100/2005), not the identifier '1005', and 'Президент на републиката' is not an official gazette issue.
False. Bulgarian Constitutional Court decisions are numbered by year (e.g., Решение №1/2026), not by a standalone “2026-01-23” date format.
False. The identifier '542/2020' is the case number, not the decision number; the cited decision is actually № 514.
False. The date 16.04.2026 is in the future, so the decision cannot yet exist in any official register.
False. Bulgarian Constitutional Court decisions use "Определение" numbering, but a 2026 date is impossible as the present year is 2024.
False. Bulgarian Supreme Court of Cassation decisions are cited by case number and year, not by a separate “решение № 361” identifier.
False. The State Gazette uses sequential issue numbers, not '1006' as an identifier for the President of the Republic.
False. The identifier '3/2027' cannot refer to a 2026 decision, as the year in the docket number must match or post-date the decision date.
False. Bulgarian Supreme Court of Cassation decisions are numbered by civil/criminal case type (e.g., № 514/2022), not solely by “решение № 514” (2022-10-14).
False. The Constitutional Court of Ukraine has no authority to issue decisions in Bulgaria, and the 2026 date is impossible.
False. Bulgarian Constitutional Court decisions use "Определение №" numbering, but no decision dated 2025-01-23 exists yet.
False. Cyprus Tax Tribunal Decisions is a Cypriot body; it cannot publish Bulgarian court decisions such as “решение № 361”.
